description: This file defines a CredentialService class that manages in-memory storage of credentials, including storing, retrieving, updating, deleting, and listing credentials with thread safety. It interfaces with security functions for encryption and decryption.

classes.name: CredentialService
classes.description: In-memory credential storage service that handles storing, retrieving, updating, deleting, and listing credentials with thread safety.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the CredentialService with an empty credential store and a threading lock.

methods.name: str _get_key(self, service_type: ServiceType, base_url: str)
methods.description: Generates a unique key for storing credentials based on service type and base URL.

methods.name: StoredCredentials store_credentials(self, request: CredentialsRequest)
methods.description: Encrypts and stores credentials based on the provided request.

methods.name: Optional[StoredCredentials] get_credentials(self, service_type: ServiceType, base_url: str)
methods.description: Retrieves stored credentials for a given service type and base URL.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,str]] get_decrypted_credentials(self, service_type: ServiceType, base_url: str)
methods.description: Retrieves credentials with decrypted password for a given service type and base URL.

methods.name: bool update_last_tested(self, service_type: ServiceType, base_url: str)
methods.description: Updates the last tested timestamp for stored credentials.

methods.name: bool delete_credentials(self, service_type: ServiceType, base_url: str)
methods.description: Deletes stored credentials for a given service type and base URL.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,str]] list_stored_services(self)
methods.description: Lists all stored, active service credentials with details.
